issues.description: The solution for Aufgabe 09 uses a numeric literal (Gemeinde.name = 12345) instead of the string 'Erlangen' required by the problem statement. This makes the reference solution incorrect and will mislead students and cause tests to fail or produce unexpected results.
issues.suggestedFix: In solution file aufgabe09.sql replace the condition Gemeinde.name=12345 with Gemeinde.name='Erlangen' (string literal with quotes). Ensure the existing join condition (Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel) remains in place so the query returns the names of zoos in the municipality named 'Erlangen'.
